granules.name: Sleep onset difficulty
granules.definition: Taking long to fall asleep.

granules.name: Sleep maintenance difficulty
granules.definition: Waking up during the night and staying awake.

granules.name: Early waking
granules.definition: Waking much earlier than intended and not falling asleep again.

granules.name: Unrefreshing sleep
granules.definition: Not feeling rested after sleep, regardless of duration.

granules.name: Daytime sleepiness / sleep need
granules.wording: Being sleepy or needing to nap during the day
granules.definition: Feeling drowsy or needing to sleep or nap during the day.

granules.name: Reversed sleep rhythm
granules.definition: Sleeping mainly by day and being awake at night.

granules.name: Sustained attention
granules.definition: Keeping attention on one thing over a period of time.

granules.name: Divided attention
granules.definition: Attending to more than one thing at once (e.g. several speakers, task + interruption).

granules.name: Processing speed
granules.definition: How fast thinking runs; slowed thought.

granules.name: Comprehension
granules.wording: Understanding what I read or hear
granules.definition: Taking in and understanding information, read or heard.

granules.name: Memory
granules.definition: Retaining and recalling information; everyday forgetting.

granules.name: Word finding
granules.definition: Retrieving the right word when speaking or writing.

granules.name: Expression
granules.definition: Putting thoughts into spoken or written language.

granules.name: Mental manipulation
granules.wording: Working things out in my head
granules.definition: Holding information in mind and working with it (e.g. mental arithmetic).

granules.name: Confusion / disorientation
granules.definition: Losing orientation or the thread: not knowing where/when, feeling muddled.

granules.name: Fatigue / energy level
granules.wording: How tired or energetic I feel
granules.definition: How tired vs. energetic one feels overall; fatigue and available energy are the two poles of one axis.

granules.name: Physical fatigability
granules.wording: Running out of steam while doing something physical
granules.definition: Tiring unusually fast DURING physical effort.

granules.name: Mental fatigability
granules.wording: Running out of steam while thinking or concentrating
granules.definition: Tiring unusually fast DURING mental effort.

granules.name: Post-exertional malaise (crash)
granules.wording: How bad my crash is after doing too much
granules.definition: Worsening of symptoms AFTER exertion, often delayed, slow recovery.

granules.name: Energy used / activity amount
granules.definition: How much energy was spent or how much was done.

granules.name: Pain
granules.definition: Physical pain of any kind; where it is located is recorded as the facet 'region'.

granules.name: Pain interference
granules.wording: How much the pain gets in the way
granules.definition: How much pain gets in the way of daily activities (impact, not intensity).

granules.name: Stiffness
granules.definition: Feeling of restricted, stiff movement (e.g. joints), distinct from pain.

granules.name: Pain sensitivity
granules.wording: How sensitive I am to pain
granules.definition: Pain from stimuli that normally hurt little or not at all, incl. pain spreading from pressure elsewhere.

granules.name: Light sensitivity
granules.definition: Light that others find normal is unpleasant, straining or makes symptoms worse.

granules.name: Noise sensitivity
granules.definition: Sounds that others find normal are unpleasant, straining or make symptoms worse.

granules.name: Vibration sensitivity
granules.definition: Vibration (e.g. car, train, machines) is unpleasant or makes symptoms worse.

granules.name: Visual focus / blurred vision
granules.wording: How sharp and clear I see
granules.definition: Eyes cannot focus; the image is blurred or narrowed.

granules.name: Depth perception
granules.definition: Judging distances and depth.

granules.name: Smell / taste change
granules.wording: Changed or lost smell or taste
granules.definition: Smell or taste weaker, lost or distorted (e.g. after COVID).

granules.name: Upright tolerance
granules.wording: How long I can sit or stand before I must lie down
granules.definition: Being able to sit or stand upright for a while without symptoms forcing you to lie down.

granules.name: Walking / moving around
granules.definition: Moving on foot; distance, stairs and terrain are the facet 'load'.

granules.name: Physical exertion
granules.wording: How much physical effort I can manage
granules.definition: Activities that need force or raise the heart rate (lifting, carrying, housework, sport).

granules.name: Activity limitation
granules.wording: How much my health limits my daily life
granules.definition: How much health reduces work and daily activities compared with normal / before illness.

granules.name: Pacing
granules.wording: How well I stay within my limits
granules.definition: Deliberately keeping activity below one's limit to avoid crashes (behaviour, not ability).

granules.name: Orthostatic intolerance
granules.wording: How unwell I get when sitting or standing upright
granules.definition: Not being able to stay upright; symptoms build up when sitting/standing and ease when lying down.

granules.name: Light-headedness / fainting
granules.definition: Feeling dizzy or faint, vision greying, nearly or actually passing out.

granules.name: Palpitations / fast heart
granules.definition: Heart racing, pounding or beating irregularly.

granules.name: Shortness of breath
granules.definition: Trouble getting enough air or catching one's breath.

granules.name: Nausea
granules.definition: Feeling sick in the stomach.

granules.name: Bowel problems
granules.definition: Diarrhoea, constipation or cramping of the bowel.

granules.name: Bloating
granules.definition: Feeling of a swollen, full belly.

granules.name: Bladder problems
granules.definition: Problems passing urine: urgency, frequency, waking at night to urinate.

granules.name: Muscle weakness
granules.definition: Muscles produce less force than normal, even before tiring.

granules.name: Muscle twitches
granules.definition: Small involuntary muscle contractions or jerks.

granules.name: Coordination
granules.definition: Precision of movements: clumsy, dropping things, missing targets.

granules.name: Balance / unsteadiness
granules.definition: Keeping stable on one's feet; feeling one might fall.

granules.name: Feeling cold / chills
granules.definition: Feeling cold, shivering or having cold hands/feet without a cold environment.

granules.name: Feeling hot / feverish
granules.definition: Feeling as if one has a raised temperature (not a measured fever).

granules.name: Temperature swings
granules.definition: Switching between hot and cold for no reason, over the day.

granules.name: Temperature intolerance
granules.wording: Coping badly with heat or cold
granules.definition: Coping badly with heat or cold in the environment.

granules.name: Sweating
granules.definition: Sweating more than the situation explains.

granules.name: Appetite loss
granules.definition: Little or no appetite.

granules.name: Unintended weight change
granules.definition: Weight going down or up without trying; direction = facet 'pole'.

granules.name: Alcohol intolerance
granules.definition: Feeling unusually unwell from small amounts of alcohol.

granules.name: Sore throat
granules.definition: Pain or scratchiness in the throat.

granules.name: Tender lymph nodes
granules.definition: Swollen or tender glands, e.g. neck, armpits.

granules.name: Flu-like feeling
granules.definition: Feeling ill as with flu: aching, feverish, run-down.

granules.name: Fever
granules.definition: Raised body temperature (ideally measured; NE2 = only feeling feverish).

granules.name: Infections
granules.definition: How often one gets infections and how long recovery takes.

granules.name: Chemical / smell sensitivity
granules.wording: Reacting to smells, chemicals or foods
granules.definition: Feeling sick from smells, chemicals, foods, medication or mold.

granules.name: Anxiety / tension
granules.wording: How anxious or calm I feel
granules.definition: Feeling nervous, tense or worried; opposite pole: calm and peaceful.

granules.name: Mood (low vs good)
granules.wording: How good or low my mood is
granules.definition: Feeling down, low or blue; opposite pole: happy.

granules.name: Emotional role limitation
granules.wording: How much my emotions limit my daily life
granules.definition: How much emotional problems reduce work and daily activities.

granules.name: Stress / feeling overwhelmed
granules.definition: Feeling under pressure or unable to cope with demands.

granules.name: Overall health
granules.wording: How good my health is overall
granules.definition: Rating of one's health as a whole.

granules.name: Overall illness level
granules.wording: How much the illness restricts me overall
granules.definition: How much the illness restricts life as a whole, from bedbound to normal.

granules.name: Global change
granules.wording: How much better or worse I am than before
granules.definition: Better or worse than at a reference point (protocol start, a year ago).

granules.name: Social limitation
granules.wording: How much my health limits my social life
granules.definition: How much health (physical or emotional) limits social activities.
